title: 2017 New York Times article as a new project using the UFO subject

tellings.quote: when I first saw that article in 2017, the New York Times article, the Kane Blumenthal thing.

plain: The idea is that the New York Times article of 16 December 2017, "Glowing Auras and 'Black Money': The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program", by the journalists Leslie Kean and Ralph Blumenthal, was not simply news but the start of a new project that used the UFO subject for its own purposes. The researcher Greg Bishop tells Michels this was his reaction when he first saw the piece, which revealed a secret Pentagon UFO study and brought the former Pentagon official Luis Elizondo to public attention. If he is right, the story that set off the modern wave of official interest was itself a managed release of information.
